The file's own title 'The check you built is an eval' is discipline-lead (naming a capability), and the only failure-adjacent language ('plausible-but-wrong is the default failure mode', L35) appears mid-argument as the reason FOR the discipline, not as a header or the lede.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity check (consolidates front-run check, module-to-module arc, Big Idea fidelity, mood-doesn't-resolve-early).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Front-run check: body only names concepts already exercised at M5/M6 (verifier, judge, gate, reference/plan/verifier triad, encode loop) — nothing from a later module is pulled forward. Module-arc: maintainer L54 states this is AE101's M6 closer, and L130 documents the deliberate choice that the closing kicker names no specific next-lecture title ('The loop feeds itself' stays thematic) because the closer chain runs the-loop-has-a-name → the-map-filled-in → agents-that-build-agents and a literal tee to the third title would assert a false adjacency — the fidelity concern was caught and fixed in-file, not left open. Mood-doesn't-resolve-early: this is the training's final closer (closes core AE101 per L54), so there is no downstream module mood this file could be prematurely resolving. Big-Idea fidelity: the file leads with and stays inside its own naming/recognition mood contract throughout (see §1). Quality line (L52-53) additionally records a fresh strategy-class PASS at 2026-08-29, one day before this pass, consistent with this reading.
